content.short: Jenius is an Indonesian digital banking app from Bank BTPN with accounts, a debit card and savings features.
content.description: Jenius is a pioneering Indonesian digital banking app launched by Bank BTPN, now part of SMBC, that lets users manage money entirely from their phones. It offers a primary account with a debit card, sub-accounts and savings features such as Flexi Saver and Dream Saver, multi-currency accounts for holding foreign currencies, and tools for splitting bills, budgeting and sending money. Aimed at Indonesia's young, digitally native consumers, Jenius helped popularize app-based banking in the country with a design-led experience and transparent fees. It competes with both traditional Indonesian banks and newer digital banks for the region's fast-growing base of mobile-first customers.
